subject_definitions:
<Picture 1> is the exact opening movie frame. Preserve every visible person's adult identity, face, hair, proportions and exact clothing. Preserve the physical layout, recurring props, time of day and photographic appearance. Do not copy the picture as a frozen still; animate the described real action within this same scene.

summary:
One continuous live-action movie shot, quiet natural human acting, physically plausible movement. After rain, a small lived-in Japanese coastal city at blue hour. Slate blue and grey shadows, dark wet pavement, restrained cream and amber practical lights, subdued natural skin. No saturated neon. Quiet, spacious, gently melancholic.

detailed_description:
[Shot 1] Start exactly from Picture 1. He waits, blinks, shifts his weight slightly, then looks up as the light changes. Soft reflected light changes subtly on his face. Camera remains quiet and close. He does not speak or smile at the camera. The whole clip stays in this one scene. No internal cuts or transitions, no change of costume, no new facial identity, no extra limbs, no warped hands, no duplicated people. Skin, hair and clothes move naturally and retain fine photographic texture. Camera motion is subtle and physically smooth. No subtitles, words, logos or watermark. No artificial image-pan effect, no freeze frame.

overall_soundscape:
Quiet environmental room tone only. All people are silent. No speech, no singing, no music.
